source.reference: Attention Training Technique is an auditory metacognitive intervention using externally focused selective attention, attention switching, and divided attention. Recent systematic-review evidence describes possible attentional effects but variable study quality, while a randomized study in probable generalized anxiety disorder did not find ATT superior to its control condition on worry outcomes.

Public content is limited to the directly described attention operations: external selection, deliberate switching, and broadening/divided attention. It makes no treatment or symptom-reduction promise.
